summary.headline: ME2ON: Kakao Games becomes largest shareholder via share purchase and rights issue (39.56%)
summary.what_happened: Kakao Games Corp. became the largest shareholder of ME2ON Co., Ltd. on Nov 27, 2026, after acquiring 7,011,390 existing shares from the former largest shareholder group led by Son Chang-wook and subscribing to 9,817,118 new shares in a third-party allotment rights issue. Following these transactions, Kakao Games holds 16,828,508 shares, or 39.56%, and the company plans to appoint its own designees as directors at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting.

key_numbers.label: Former largest shareholder group stake before change

summary.why_it_matters: A change in largest shareholder in Korea typically signals a shift in control of the listed company, which can lead to changes in board composition and management direction. Shareholders may also see new shares issued through third-party allotments, which can affect the ownership percentages of existing holders.
